tools.name: get_balance
tools.description:
Get the balance

The prepaid balance and how to top it up from code: over x402 with USDC (when switched on) or with a card link for a person (the `create_topup_checkout` tool). Takes an agent session or a management key like every v1 operation; a model key gets 403 wrong_key_type. Also served at /v1

Set the account budget

tools.name: remove_account_budget
tools.description:
Remove the account budget

Removes the account's budget: the keys' own budgets stay. 404 not_found when there is none. 204 with no body.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description:
List customers

Your customers, newest first. Filter by your own id (externalRef, exact), a search over name, email and externalRef (q, case-insensitive), or status.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description:
Create a customer

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description:
Get a customer

One of your customers.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description:
Update a customer

Changes only the fields you send. Pause a customer to stop its keys; spendLimitUsd sets its monthly limit and null removes it.

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description:
Delete a customer

Deletes the customer, its balance history and all its keys, which stop working at once. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: credit_customer
tools.description:
Record a customer payment

tools.name: list_customer_keys
tools.description:
List a customer's keys

The customer's model keys, newest first: working keys only unless includeRevoked=true. Secrets are never shown again.

tools.name: create_customer_key
tools.description:
Create a key for a customer

Creates a model key for the customer. The secret is in this response only. Calls with it are billed to your balance at our price. At most 50 working keys per customer, and 5,000 new customer keys a day per account: past either, 409 limit_reached.

tools.name: revoke_customer_key
tools.description:
Revoke a customer's key

Revokes the key; it stops working at once. 404 when the key is not this customer's or is already revoked.

tools.name: list_customer_ledger
tools.description:
List a customer's recorded payments

Payments and corrections you recorded for this customer, newest first. Its usage is not here: it is debited from your balance (see /ledger and /usage).

tools.name: list_gateways

List gateways

tools.name: create_gateway
tools.description:
Create a gateway

Saves a new gateway from its config, validated and normalized; the stored config comes back. The name is its id here and in the x-klinn-gateway header: a-z, 0-9 and -, at most 48 characters, and not new, playground, rules or templates (the console's own pages); a name already in us

tools.name: get_gateway
tools.description:
Get a gateway

The gateway's stored config (what create and replace accept, normalized), the ids of the keys it is the default of, and when it was created and last changed.

tools.name: update_gateway
tools.description:
Replace a gateway

Replaces the whole config: send the config from the `get_gateway` tool with your changes. Fields left out take their defaults and the same checks apply as on create. A body without a name keeps this one; a different name renames the gateway (a name already in use is 409 conflict)

tools.name: delete_gateway
tools.description:
Delete a gateway

Get a decision gateway's answers

tools.name: gateway_stats

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description:
List instances

The account's instances, running ones first, then the newest. A running instance is billed up to now when read, so billedSeconds and billedUsd are current.

tools.name: start_instance
tools.description:
Start an instance

Starts a machine for one model: gpuClass (default h200) and size (eighths of a node, default 1) pick its spec and price, fixed for as long as it runs. Billing is per second while it runs, one minute at least: the first minute is debited at once. From the next call on (within a few

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description:
Get an instance

One instance, billed up to now when it runs.

tools.name: update_instance
tools.description:
Set an instance's timer

Sets when a running instance stops by itself: hours from now (to extend it, or shorten it), or null to run until stopped. The price and limits stay as they are; billing stays per second. 409 conflict when it has already stopped.

tools.name: stop_instance
tools.description:
Stop an instance

Stops it now and bills it to this second (one minute at least). From the next call on, calls to its model are billed per token again. Stopping a stopped instance answers it as it is.

tools.name: request_dedicated_hardware
tools.description:
Ask for dedicated hardware

Tells OpenCheap the account would rent dedicated hardware: the GPU class, region, model and hours a month. Stored, and answered by email to the account's address. Starts nothing and bills nothing.

tools.name: list_instance_types
tools.description:
List instance types

What can be started: each model with its machines. A machine is sized like a share of one 8-GPU node of a class (gpuClass: the class the model is offered on; size in eighths of a node: 1, 2, 4 or 8) and has a spec (parallel streams, target output tokens a second per stream, cont

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description:
List model keys

The account's own model keys (`kl_live_…`), newest first. Customer keys are listed under /customers/{id}/keys and management keys under /management-keys. Revoked keys are left out unless `includeRevoked=true`.

tools.name: create_key
tools.description:
Create a model key

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description:
Revoke a model key

Revokes one of the account's own model keys. It stops working at once. A key that is already revoked, belongs to a customer or does not exist answers 404.

tools.name: get_key_budget
tools.description:

One key's budget (any working model key of the account, a customer's included: the keys the `list_budgets` tool lists), each limit with its spend this window. Its monthly limit is the key's monthlyLimitUsd, so a key created with a monthly cap has a budget (hard_stop, no alert). 4

tools.name: remove_key_budget
tools.description:
Remove a key's budget

Removes one key's budget, its monthly limit (monthlyLimitUsd) included: the key is limited by the account's budget only, if there is one. 204 with no body, also when the key had none.

tools.name: list_ledger
tools.description:

Every movement of the prepaid balance, newest first: top-ups, grants, usage charges (yours and your customers') and adjustments.

tools.name: list_management_keys
tools.description:
List agent keys

The account's agent keys (`kl_rs_…`, management keys) for agents and backends, newest first, without their secrets. Active keys only unless `includeRevoked=true`.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description:
List models and prices

Models the Model API serves at a fixed price per token, with our price per million prompt and completion tokens, sorted by id and paged: 100 per page by default, up to 200. `q` narrows the list to models whose id or name contains it (case-insensitive). The list is large: sear

The model's order book as a seller sees it: the asks by price level, cheapest first (up to 20), what buyers pay and what a seller there earns (buyers pay divided by the fee), how many asks stand at each level, and which level is yours. Price against it: set your own price

tools.description:
List saved vendor keys

The account's saved vendor API keys, newest first: the vendor prefix and last four only. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: discover_models
tools.description:

Replaces a saved key with a new key of the same vendor (an own server: a new address or key): sealed like the first, its offers move to it, the old one stops serving within a minute, and a health test runs on the new one. The same key again is a 400. Sellers only: an account that

tools.name: get_supply_earnings

Read selling earnings

tools.name: list_supply_earnings
tools.description:
List served requests

Each request your offers served, newest first: the time to the minute, the model, tokens, your rate and what you earned; at least an hour late, never a buyer or a request id. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: get_supply_job
tools.description:
Read a selling job

A discovery, health test or identity check: its status and, once done, its result. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description:
List offers

Every offer of the account: model, key, status, price, checks, health (the last liveness ping and identity probe), and the model's market as a seller sees it (anonymised levels, the best discount, the gap to it, outbid, whether your ask rests in the book and its rank). Sellers only: an

Draft offers from a key's models

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description:
Read an offer

One offer with its status, checks, health and market. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.description:
Price an offer

tools.name: discard_offer
tools.description:
Discard a draft offer

Deletes a draft that never went live; a listed offer is cancelled instead (the `cancel_offer` tool). Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: cancel_offer
tools.description:
Cancel an offer

Ends the offer for good. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: get_offer_health
tools.description:
Read an offer's health log

The offer's health events, newest first: the reason, time to first token (p95), answers and failures in the hour, and an error category. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: pause_offer
tools.description:
Pause an offer

Stops routing to the offer until it is resumed. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: publish_offer
tools.description:
Publish an offer

Lists a draft whose health test and identity checks passed: it goes live within about a minute and is checked continuously from then on. Its key needs the seller's statement on record: pass `statement` (the version from the `list_supply_presets` tool) to accept it. A draft not read

tools.name: reset_offer_health
tools.description:
Reset an offer's health

Runs a fresh health test on the key; the offer is routed again once it answers. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: resume_offer
tools.description:
Resume an offer

Routes to a paused offer again. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: test_offer
tools.description:
Test an offer

The health test (one short streamed request on your key, about 16 tokens) and, for a draft, the identity checks (a few hundred tokens). Read the outcome with the `get_offer` tool. A draft that fails either check is deleted (contract v2.4): `get_offer` answers 404 and the job (`get_sup

tools.name: bulk_offer_action
tools.description:
Pause, resume, cancel or reset several offers

The same action on up to 100 offers; each one's outcome, so one refusal does not stop the rest. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: get_payout_address
tools.description:
Read the payout address

Where payouts go: the address the seller saved (USDC on Base), when it last changed, and until when a payout to it waits (24 hours after a change), or null. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: get_supply_payouts
tools.description:
Read payouts

Owed, available, requested and paid out, what is held and why, the payout address and the payout history (Requested, Sent with its transaction, Failed or returned). Payouts are sent manually in USDC on Base, usually within 72 hours: `canRequest` says whether one can be requested now an

tools.description:
List what a key can be listed for

What a key can be listed for. Today: custom, your own OpenAI-compatible server (any model it serves), and zai with a GLM Coding Plan key. The other vendors (OpenAI, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, Moonshot, and Z.ai open platform keys) are listed with `comingSoon: true

tools.name: get_seller
tools.description:
Read the account's seller status

Whether the account sells, its standing and limits. Not a seller yet: `seller: false`.

tools.name: update_seller
tools.description:
Set the seller's daily cap and concurrency

Your own daily earnings cap in USD (resets 00:00 UTC; null for none) and the requests at once per offer (1 to 32). Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

tools.name: create_topup_checkout
tools.description:
Create a card top-up link

A card checkout link (Stripe Checkout) for a person to top up this account. Open the `url` in a browser; the balance is credited when the payment completes. Card top-ups start at $5, in whole dollars, with no maximum of ours: a smaller amount is raised to $5, and the reply

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
Get usage

Requests, tokens and spend over the last `days` whole UTC days, today included (days=1 is today so far), in total and by day, model and key. Every breakdown counts the same hours, so the totals equal the sum of byDay, of byModel and of byKey. Spend is what the account was charged, at our

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description:
List wallets and invites

Every wallet that signs in to this account with Sign-In with Ethereum (`status: active`), then the wallets invited to join it (`status: invited`). `role` is owner for the wallet that opened an agent's own account and delegate for every other wallet and invite.

tools.name: remove_wallet
tools.description:
Remove a wallet or cancel an invite

Removes an active wallet or cancels an invite. The owner can remove any wallet except its own (409 own_wallet). A delegate wallet can remove only its own wallet: it leaves the account, and its session ends. Anyone else gets 403 owner_only. Removing an active wall

tools.name: get_whoami
tools.description:
Check who is signed in

The account and the credential behind this request: an agent session (owner or delegate, with its wallet and expiry) or a management key (a delegate), and the permissions it carries. A cheap call to check a credential.
